descriptionChirho: The gentilic adjective/noun designating a person from Moab, used for both males and females, singular and plural. All four clusters represent inflectional and gender/number variants of the same gentilic: the Moabitess (S110024), Moabite women (S110025), the Moabites (S110026), and a Moabite man (S110027). Arabic consistently uses al-mu'abiyyah/mu'abiyyin (الْمُوآبِيَّة/مُوآبِيّ), Spanish 'moabita/moabitas', Hindi 'Moaabee' (मोआबी) throughout, Korean 'Moap yeo-in/Moap-in' (모압 여인/모압인), and Swahili 'Mmoabu/Wamoabu'. These are grammatical variants (gender, number, article, conjunction) of one gentilic sense.
